device: a108:c309 (bootrom), a T31ZX camera on a phone's USB OTG
magic:  not captured (the Android app reads the three registers only; no --diag)

[1] registers via kseg1 (0xB3......), the address form --diag uses:
  soc_id       @0xB300002C = 0x10031003
  subsoctype1  @0xB3540238 = 0x66661111
  subsoctype2  @0xB3540250 = 0x00000000

  cpu_id=0x0031  sub1=0x6666  sub2=0x0000
  => T31ZX  (loader dir: t31x)

source: the Android app run of 2026-09-03, read from the app's own
log with the core's debug narration on:
  identified: chip=T31ZX grade=0x6666 evidence=Vendor loader=t31x regs=SocRegs { soc_id: 268636163, subsoctype1: 1717965073, subsoctype2: 0, t33_selector: None }
The same unit was detected as T31ZX and flashed from the t31x loader over WebUSB earlier
the same day, without a register capture. Through the app it bootstrapped from the t31x
loader (tpl.bin + uboot.bin), read 32 MiB (SHA-256 909a3b86...) and wrote with verify;
the eFuse window was not read on this run.
